welcome_body: Your electricity bill depends on who owns the wires to your home. With your position we find your grid company, so the prices in the app are the ones you actually pay.
welcome_zone_body: The electricity price depends on your price zone. Choose your country and the app shows the spot price hour by hour.
searching_hint: This takes a moment. Your position is not stored.
place_no_match: No countries or grid companies match “%1$s”.
note_no_position: We could not find your position. Choose your grid company from the list instead.
note_outside_denmark: Your position is outside Denmark. Choose your country from the list.
note_no_net: We could not find the grid company for your position. Choose it from the list — it is on your electricity bill.
note_lookup_failed: The lookup failed. Choose your grid company from the list, or try again later.
note_denied: Your position was not shared. Choose your grid company from the list — the app works the same way.
place_position_note: Finds your grid company from your position. The position is used once and never stored.
place_net_note: With a grid company the price includes grid tariff, taxes and VAT as on your bill.
place_zone_note: This country has several price zones. Choose the one you live in.
note_zone_de_lu: Germany and Luxembourg share one price zone (DE-LU).
note_zone_it_n: The price is for the Northern Italy bidding zone (IT-North).
location_usage: Elpriser uses your position once, when you tap “Use my position”, to find your grid company. The position is never stored — only the name of the grid company.
